adminLibraryStudio.background: Warm paper #f4f3eb with background pseudo-elements removed; near-ivory #fffef9 tools and cards; sage filter, outline and preview frames. Relevant scholar-library/exam-pavilion artwork stays in compact headers; category book covers do not depict uploaded contents.
adminLibraryStudio.typography: Scoped Noto Sans, Noto Sans SC, sans-serif at 16px/1.7; headings share the stack and input, textarea, select and button inherit it. Fields use 16px/1.6, labels 14px/1.6 weight 600. Vocabulary preview Hanzi is 56px; quick-glimpse Hanzi is 44px Noto Sans SC.
adminLibraryStudio.fields: Near-ivory #fffefb ground, #253c32 text and #bcc8ba border; textarea minimum height 96px with vertical resize; 3px #a95b2b focus outline offset 3px. These are administration overrides, not replacements for shared/public field variants.

layout.library: Results plus 240?300px sticky quick preview, 24px gap. At 1250px: 250px preview, 18px gap, one card column. At 800px: stacked preview and two card columns. At 480px: one horizontal cover-and-copy card column. A sole result also uses a horizontal card. Tables scroll in a labeled focusable region.
layout.workshop: 200px sticky outline plus content stage; editor/preview columns at 1.15:0.85 with 240px preview minimum and 24px gap. At 1250px: 160px outline, 16px gap and stacked edit/preview. At 800px: wrapping outline, static preview and explicit Edit/Preview controls. Hidden panes remain mounted.

adminLibraryStudio.selection: Quick summary resolves only against records on the current filtered result page, using the matching selected ID or first visible record; no visible record means no summary. Title buttons select, separate links open canonical destinations. Pagination remains external to AdminLibrary.
adminLibraryStudio.drafts: In-memory mounted drafts survive item, area and mobile pane switches in the current record session. Explicit item saves retain failed input and update only the saved item baseline. Aggregate dirty state protects route departure/browser unload and disables lesson publish and assessment review/publish. Existing lifecycle/read-only/deletion restrictions remain authoritative.
adminLibraryStudio.contentOwnership: Separate shared canonical content fields from lesson order/note/example. Explain shared effects; detachment removes only the lesson association.
adminLibraryStudio.preview: Current draft student-style content with unsaved labels, supported exact-match illustrations and local interactive question answers through the learner renderer. Question answer keys, accepted answers and rubrics stay in the editor. Previews have no learner progress, submission or publication side effects and do not represent a full learner session.

academyVisualsVi.scope: Contextual learner and administration artwork; Vietnamese administration presentation. Extends Bo's Illustrated Academy without replacing incumbent tokens, layouts, workflows or public/learner copy.

atlas.deliveryTreatment: Lossless WebP derivative with identical alpha; original generated PNG retained unmodified. Preserve watercolor transparency without thresholding, background removal or cross-cell cropping.
atlas.canvas: 1536x1024 RGBA; 3 columns by 2 rows; 512x512 square cells; left to right, top to bottom.

mapping.covers: Lessons use supported title matches or neutral study; assessments use practice; source documents use library. Covers identify topic/category and do not depict uploaded file contents.
mapping.routeContext: Documents and history: library; assessments: practice; pronunciation, curriculum and HSK: path; otherwise study.
mapping.companions: Practice defaults to B?t; library to Tr?c; other scene headers to Bo guide. Explicit real lesson completion uses celebrate; unfinished lessons use think. Preserve other explicit progress-based pose choices.
mapping.integration: ArtworkProvider supplies context inside learner/admin surfaces. PageHeader defaults to HeaderArtwork, accepts explicit artwork/scene and permits artwork=false. Contextual EmptyState uses a compact relevant scene beside real text/action. Decorative scenes, header art and section icons are hidden from assistive technology.

layout.desktopHeader: Flexible copy plus 180px artwork column, 16px/24px row/column gaps, 156px minimum height and 24px/28px padding. Artwork region 180x144px; 150px square scene; 76px square companion overlapping lower right. Actions use a separate full-width second row.
layout.mobileHeader: At 700px: 100px artwork column, 12px gaps, 20px padding, 124px minimum height; 96px scene and 50px companion. At 440px: one column with artwork, copy, then actions; artwork height 86px. Flexible copy retains min-width:0 and wraps.
layout.adminDashboardHeader: Dedicated heading grid with 164x132px artwork. At 1100px artwork becomes 120x112px and create action moves beneath. At 440px artwork, copy and create action stack in that order.
layout.squarePreviews: Scene cells retain aspect-ratio:1 and flex-shrink:0. Admin student word art is 144px wide, max-width:100%, height:auto, min-height:0, aspect-ratio:1 and border-box sizing; quick glimpse pairs 92px square art with flexible text and 34px Hanzi. Preserve supported exact-match word art and avoid cross-axis stretching.

semanticIcons.treatment: Native SVG, 24px view box, no fill, currentColor 1.7px stroke, round caps/joins; 24px section icons inside 44px tonal tiles. Keep visible labels understandable without icons.

administrationPresentation.language: Vietnamese navigation, headings, labels, status names, question types, confirmations, errors, upload controls and local question-preview controls, including administration logout.
administrationPresentation.labels: Known API values map through adminLabel; unknown values remain visible; missing values show an em dash.
administrationPresentation.dates: adminDate uses Intl.DateTimeFormat vi-VN with medium date and short time; missing values show an em dash and invalid dates show Ch?a x?c ??nh.
administrationPresentation.boundary: Presentation only: preserve API enums/payload fields, identifiers, lifecycle and progress rules, authored lesson/source text and existing public/learner interface copy.

narrative.overview:
A calm painted academy frames practical study. Pine navigation, pale paper and ivory reading surfaces make room for an expressive dragon named Bo. Local Noto Sans keeps Vietnamese explanations direct and comfortable; Noto Sans SC gives Chinese learning material a distinct, larger voice.

Illustration accompanies the task: Bo welcomes, guides and responds; Trúc explains; Bút supports practice. Reading surfaces remain quiet so the learner can distinguish a sound, Hanzi, pinyin, meaning and evidence. Public authentication and administration share the palette and type identity while retaining their existing workflows. Administration extends this academy through quiet management panels, real-record libraries and a focused authoring workshop with explicit item saves and local student-style previews.

The contextual artwork extension is recorded in `.impeccable/surfaces/academy-visuals-vi.md`. It adds watercolor scenes, semantic outlined icons and activity companions across learner and administration surfaces, while keeping the incumbent identity and content workflows. Administration interface copy is Vietnamese; this presentation scope does not change authored content or public and learner interface copy.
keyCharacteristics: Painted academy scenery with a contextual companion cast.
Large Chinese learning content and adjustable Vietnamese reading text.
Pine navigation, ivory reading cards and restrained tonal boundaries.
Explicit progress, availability, source references and action states.

rules.name: The Quiet Page Rule
rules.body: Keep explanatory and vocabulary surfaces ivory or pale sage; place painted scenery in the surrounding academy and dedicated scene regions.

rules.name: The Chinese First Rule
rules.body: Make Hanzi the vocabulary entry's strongest text, followed by pinyin and Vietnamese meaning; keep the example and explanatory note adjacent when details expand.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve the academy lesson and pronunciation cards' shadow-free reading plane; use elevation to explain an overlay or contextual floating surface.

rules.name: The Current Page Rule
rules.body: Resolve the library quick summary from the visible filtered result page; keep selecting a summary distinct from opening the canonical editor.

rules.name: The Mounted Draft Rule
rules.body: Retain inactive item editors and workspace areas while switching, protect unsaved departure and save each item explicitly. Draft retention lasts within the mounted record session.

rules.name: The Honest Preview Rule
rules.body: Show the current draft with an unsaved label, keep grading answers in the editor and keep preview interactions local without recording learning results or publishing.

dos: **Do** keep Vietnamese explanations readable and Chinese content visually distinct with the locally served Noto families.
**Do** preserve all three reading-size choices and the optional vocabulary pinyin preference.
**Do** use Bo, Trúc and Bút according to their contextual roles and preserve sprite proportions.
**Do** keep examples, notes, source references, save states and errors next to the material or action they explain.
**Do** derive progress, completion and availability from the API; store only presentation preferences locally in the production academy.
**Do** keep administration's lesson and practice actions ahead of supporting statistics, with real drafts and adjacent data-state feedback.
**Do** keep library selection tied to the current result page and distinguish selecting a quick summary from opening its canonical editor.
**Do** preserve mounted authoring drafts across item, area and mobile pane switches, with explicit per-item saves and honest unsaved preview labels.
**Do** choose topic artwork only for supported title matches and use the reading desk as the neutral lesson fallback.
**Do** keep scene and word-art cells square, preserve transparent edges and let narrow-screen header controls wrap beneath the content.
**Do** present administration controls, status labels and dates in Vietnamese while preserving API values and authored content.
donts: **Don't** show an unrelated vocabulary picture or imply complete illustration coverage.
**Don't** replace real completion or unlock rules with prototype sample progress.
**Don't** reduce Chinese or Vietnamese font coverage to the prototype's limited subset.
**Don't** promote legacy cascade artifacts, heading kickers, thick colored section stripes or inherited ornamental gradients into reusable academy rules.
**Don't** treat the local textbook PDF as a public visual asset; keep concise source-page references visible in the lesson.
**Don't** imply that category covers depict uploaded content, or that an administration preview records a learner result or publishes a draft.
**Don't** apply the scoped administration workspace's typography, field or background overrides to learner and public surfaces.
**Don't** infer completion from decorative scenes, translate authored lesson/source material automatically, or extend administration copy changes into public and learner surfaces.
